title: Red/Green Luffy & Ace
summary: Built around Starter Deck 30 (EX Luffy & Ace). Fast Luffy cards attack the turn they're played, and the Leader makes all your Luffy and Ace cards much harder to beat on your opponent's turn.
gamePlan: Early turns: play cheap searchers like Nami and Jewelry Bonney. They look at the top of your deck and grab Straw Hat Crew cards. Thousand Sunny does the same.
From turn 3 or 4: play Monkey.D.Luffy (ST30-012) and rest 1 DON!! to give it [Rush], or play Monkey.D.Luffy (ST21-014), which already has [Rush]. Attack right away.
On your opponent's turn your Leader gives every Luffy and Ace card +3000 power, so attacking into them is hard. Your Leader itself has 6000 power.
Avoid Characters with 7000 base power or more: having one drops your Leader to 4000. That's why this deck stays with 6000-power Luffys.

keyCards.why: Leader. +3000 to all your Luffy and Ace cards on your opponent's turn.
4 cost, 6000 power. Can gain [Rush], and rests one of your opponent's Blockers when it attacks.
5 cost [Rush] Luffy that gives a DON!! to your team when it attacks.
Draws a card and plays another Straw Hat from your hand for free.
Event that digs 4 cards deep for the Character you need.
Counter event: +3000 power for 0 DON!! (you trash 1 card from hand).

howItWins: Pressure. You attack with several Luffys every turn, and the Leader's +3000 on defense keeps them alive to attack again.
weakTo: Decks that rest or K.O. your Characters before they can attack.
Opponents with lots of Blockers. Each ST30-012 attack can rest only one.
mulliganTips: Keep a hand with at least one 1-cost searcher and one 4 or 5 cost Luffy. Redraw hands full of Events.
